answer: Pay rewards into a vesting vault, not a wallet. Each identity's earnings unlock only after 30 epochs, and anyone who proves two identities share one operator (same key reuse, same funding thread, matching answers) claims half of both vaults while the rest is burned. So a farmer running 100 fakes called juniper-1 to juniper-100 always has a month of income at risk, and every member of the farm is a bounty waiting for a hunter. Faking identities stops paying once one link is found.
